name: netarchitect
description: Offline-first IPv4 Subnet Calculator, VLSM Allocator, Network Planner & Security Auditor
author: Lance0519 <justinelance0067@gmail.com>

scripts.verify:theme:all: node scripts/verify-theme.cjs web && node scripts/verify-theme.cjs ios && node scripts/verify-theme.cjs android
scripts.//check: typecheck + lint + format + test + the stylesheet assertion + the class-order rule. The last two are in here, not optional, because both catch failures that every other step in this chain reports as green: two bugs in global.css left the app permanently in light mode, and a misordered cn() argument silently stops a component honouring a caller's rounded-*/max-w-*/p-* override. A gate that cannot catch a bug is not a gate.
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run check:classes && npm run verify:theme:all
scripts.//verify: the full release gate: everything in `check`, then real Android and web builds, then assertions against the resulting bundles.
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run export:probe && npm run verify:bundle && npm run export:probe:web && npm run verify:bundle:web
